title: The Book of Song of Solomon Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Song of Solomon — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
verses.decoded: This is the greatest song, attributed to Solomon.

verses.kjv: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
verses.decoded: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth, because your love is better than wine.

verses.kjv: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
verses.decoded: Because your fragrant oils smell so good, your name spreads like perfume, and that’s why young women love you.

verses.kjv: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
verses.decoded: Pull me closer, and we will follow you. The king has taken me into his private rooms. We will be happy and celebrate you, remembering your love more than wine. Honest people love you.

verses.kjv: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
verses.decoded: I am dark-skinned but beautiful, you women of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar and the curtains of Solomon.

verses.kjv: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
verses.decoded: Don’t look down on me because I’m dark; the sun has tanned me. My brothers were angry with me and made me watch the vineyards, but I didn’t take care of my own.

verses.kjv: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
verses.decoded: Tell me, my beloved, where you graze your sheep and rest them at midday, so I won’t wander among your friends’ flocks.

verses.kjv: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents.
verses.decoded: If you don’t know, most beautiful woman, follow the sheep’s tracks and graze your young goats near the shepherds’ tents.

verses.kjv: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.decoded: I compare you, my love, to a group of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.

verses.kjv: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
verses.decoded: Your cheeks are beautiful, decorated like rows of jewels, and your neck is like gold chains.

verses.kjv: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
verses.decoded: We will make your borders of gold, decorated with silver studs.

verses.kjv: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
verses.decoded: While the king sits at his table, my perfume of spikenard fills the air.

verses.kjv: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
verses.decoded: My beloved is like a bundle of myrrh to me; he will rest all night between my breasts.

verses.kjv: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.
verses.decoded: My beloved is like a cluster of cypress trees in the vineyards of Engedi to me.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes.
verses.decoded: Look, you are beautiful, my love; truly, you are beautiful, with eyes like doves.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
verses.decoded: Look, you are beautiful, my beloved, truly delightful; our bed is covered with fresh green plants.

verses.kjv: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.
verses.decoded: The beams of our house are made of cedar wood, and our rafters are made of fir.

verses.kjv: I AM the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
verses.decoded: I am like a beautiful flower from Sharon, like a lily growing in the valleys.

verses.kjv: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
verses.decoded: Just as a lily stands out among thorns, my beloved stands out among other women.

verses.kjv: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.decoded: My beloved is like an apple tree in a forest of trees. I happily rested in his shade, and his love was sweet to me.

verses.kjv: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
verses.decoded: He invited me to a feast, and his love was like a banner flying over me.

verses.kjv: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.
verses.decoded: Refresh me with wine and comfort me with apples, because I am overwhelmed by love.

verses.kjv: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
verses.decoded: He supports my head with his left hand and holds me close with his right arm.

verses.kjv: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
verses.decoded: I ask you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gentle deer of the fields, do not disturb or awaken my love until he is ready.

verses.kjv: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
verses.decoded: I hear my beloved’s voice! Look, he is coming, jumping over the mountains and running across the hills.

verses.kjv: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
verses.decoded: My beloved is like a young deer. Look, he is standing behind our wall, peeking through the window, showing himself through the lattice.

verses.kjv: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.decoded: My beloved spoke to me, saying, 'Get up, my love, my beautiful one, and come with me.'

verses.kjv: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
verses.decoded: Look, winter is over, and the rain has stopped.

verses.kjv: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
verses.decoded: Flowers are blooming; the birds are singing, and the sound of the turtledove is heard in our land.

verses.kjv: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.decoded: The fig tree is growing its green figs, and the grapevines are giving off a sweet smell. Get up, my love, my beautiful one, and come with me.

verses.kjv: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.
verses.decoded: My dove, hiding in the rocky crevices and secret places, let me see your face and hear your voice, because your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.

verses.kjv: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
verses.decoded: Catch the little foxes that ruin the vineyards, because our vineyards have delicate grapes.

verses.kjv: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.decoded: My beloved belongs to me, and I belong to him; he rests among the lilies.

verses.kjv: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
verses.decoded: Until dawn comes and the shadows disappear, turn back, my beloved, and be like a graceful deer or young stag on the mountains of Bether.

verses.kjv: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.decoded: At night, while lying in bed, I searched for the one my soul loves, but I couldn't find him.

verses.kjv: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.decoded: I will get up and walk through the city streets and main roads to look for the one my soul loves, but I still can't find him.

verses.kjv: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
verses.decoded: The city guards found me and I asked them, 'Have you seen the one my soul loves?'

verses.kjv: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
verses.decoded: I had only just passed by them when I found the one my soul loves. I held him tight and wouldn’t let him go until I brought him into my mother’s house, into the room where I was born.

verses.kjv: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
verses.decoded: I warn you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gentle deer of the fields, don’t disturb or wake my love until he is ready.

verses.kjv: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
verses.decoded: Who is this coming out of the wilderness, like columns of smoke, scented with myrrh, frankincense, and all kinds of fragrant spices?

verses.kjv: Behold his bed, which is Solomon’s; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.
verses.decoded: Look at his bed, which belongs to Solomon; sixty brave warriors, the strongest men of Israel, surround it.

verses.kjv: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
verses.decoded: All of them carry swords and are skilled fighters; each has his sword ready at his side, guarding against danger at night.

verses.kjv: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
verses.decoded: King Solomon made himself a chariot from Lebanon cedar wood.

verses.kjv: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He decorated it with silver pillars, a gold base, covered it with purple cloth, and the center was filled with love, made for the daughters of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.decoded: Come out, daughters of Zion, and see King Solomon wearing the crown his mother gave him on his wedding day, a day full of joy.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
verses.decoded: Look, you are beautiful, my beloved; truly, you are beautiful. Your eyes are gentle and pure like doves hidden in your hair; your hair flows like a herd of goats coming down from Mount Gilead.

verses.kjv: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
verses.decoded: Your teeth are like a well-kept flock of freshly washed sheep, all paired and healthy, with no missing teeth.

verses.kjv: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
verses.decoded: Your lips are bright red and beautiful, and your words are pleasant. Your cheeks glow like the inside of a pomegranate hidden in your hair.

verses.kjv: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
verses.decoded: Your neck is strong and graceful like the Tower of David, fortified and decorated with a thousand shields of brave warriors.

verses.kjv: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
verses.decoded: Your two breasts are like twin young deer, gently feeding among the lilies.

verses.kjv: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
verses.decoded: Until morning comes and the shadows disappear, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and the hill of frankincense.

verses.kjv: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.
verses.decoded: You are completely beautiful, my beloved; there is nothing flawed in you.

verses.kjv: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
verses.decoded: Come away with me from Lebanon, my bride; come with me. Look from the peaks of Amana, Shenir, and Hermon, from the dens of lions and the mountains where leopards live.

verses.kjv: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
verses.decoded: You have captured my heart, my sister and bride; you have captured it with just one glance from your eyes and one necklace around your neck.

verses.kjv: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
verses.decoded: How beautiful is your love, my sister and bride! Your love is better than wine, and the fragrance of your perfumes is sweeter than all spices.

verses.kjv: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
verses.decoded: Your lips, my bride, drip with sweetness like honeycomb; honey and milk flow beneath your tongue. The scent of your clothes is like the fragrance of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
verses.decoded: My sister and bride is like a private garden, a locked spring, a sealed fountain.

verses.kjv: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
verses.decoded: Your plants are like an orchard of pomegranates with delightful fruits, along with fragrant camphor and spikenard.

verses.kjv: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
verses.decoded: There is spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, all kinds of frankincense trees, myrrh and aloes, and all the finest spices.

verses.kjv: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
verses.decoded: You are like a fountain in a garden, a well of fresh water, flowing streams from Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
verses.decoded: Come, north wind, and come, south wind; blow through my garden so its fragrance can spread. Let my beloved enter his garden and enjoy its delightful fruits.

verses.kjv: I AM come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.
verses.decoded: I have entered my garden, my sister, my wife. I have gathered my fragrant spices; I have eaten honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk wine mixed with milk. Friends, eat and drink freely, my beloved.

verses.kjv: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying, Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.
verses.decoded: I am asleep, but my heart is awake. I hear my beloved knocking, saying, 'Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my pure one, for my head is covered with dew and my hair with the dampness of the night.'

verses.kjv: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
verses.decoded: I took off my robe; how can I put it back on? I washed my feet; how can I dirty them again?

verses.kjv: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.
verses.decoded: My beloved reached his hand through the door, and I was deeply moved inside because of him.

verses.kjv: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.
verses.decoded: I got up to open the door for my beloved, but my hands were dripping with myrrh, and my fingers with fragrant myrrh, on the door’s lock.

verses.kjv: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
verses.decoded: I opened the door for my beloved, but he had already left. My heart sank when he spoke. I searched for him but couldn’t find him; I called out, but he did not answer.

verses.kjv: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
verses.decoded: The city guards found me as I searched; they beat me and wounded me. The gatekeepers took my veil from me.

verses.kjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.
verses.decoded: I ask you, daughters of Jerusalem, if you find my beloved, please tell him that I am lovesick.

verses.kjv: What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?
verses.decoded: What makes your beloved better than others, O most beautiful woman? What makes your beloved different that you ask us to speak for him?

verses.kjv: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
verses.decoded: My beloved is radiant and healthy-looking, the best among ten thousand.

verses.kjv: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.
verses.decoded: His head is like pure gold; his hair is thick and black like a raven’s feathers.

verses.kjv: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.
verses.decoded: His eyes are like gentle doves by streams of water, pure and perfectly set.

verses.kjv: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.
verses.decoded: His cheeks are like a bed of fragrant spices and sweet flowers; his lips are like lilies dripping with fragrant myrrh.

verses.kjv: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.
verses.decoded: His hands are like gold rings decorated with precious gems; his torso is like bright ivory adorned with sapphires.

verses.kjv: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
verses.decoded: His legs are like marble pillars set on bases of pure gold; his appearance is majestic like the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: His words are very sweet; indeed, he is completely wonderful. This is my beloved, and he is also my friend, O women of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
verses.decoded: Where has your beloved gone, you most beautiful woman? Where has your beloved turned? So we can look for him with you.

verses.kjv: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
verses.decoded: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the spice beds, to enjoy the gardens and pick lilies.

verses.kjv: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.decoded: I belong to my beloved, and my beloved belongs to me; he feeds among the lilies.

verses.kjv: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.
verses.decoded: You are beautiful, my love, as lovely as Tirzah, as attractive as Jerusalem, and as powerful as an army with banners.

verses.kjv: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
verses.decoded: Look away from me, because your eyes have overwhelmed me; your hair is like a flock of goats coming down from Gilead.

verses.kjv: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
verses.decoded: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing; each one has twins, and none are missing.

verses.kjv: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
verses.decoded: Your temples, hidden beneath your hair, are like a slice of pomegranate.

verses.kjv: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
verses.decoded: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and countless virgins.

verses.kjv: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
verses.decoded: My dove, my pure one, is the only one; she is the only daughter of her mother, the chosen one of the woman who gave birth to her. The daughters saw her and blessed her; even the queens and concubines praised her.

verses.kjv: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
verses.decoded: Who is this woman, shining like the morning, beautiful as the moon, bright as the sun, and powerful like an army with banners?

verses.kjv: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.
verses.decoded: I went down into the walnut grove to see the fruit of the valley, to see if the vines were flourishing and the pomegranates were budding.

verses.kjv: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
verses.decoded: Before I realized it, my soul set me among the chariots of Amminadib.

verses.kjv: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
verses.decoded: Come back, come back, O Shulamite; come back, so we can see you. What will you see in the Shulamite? Like the formation of two armies.

verses.kjv: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince’s daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
verses.decoded: How lovely are your feet in your sandals, princess! The curves of your thighs are like beautiful jewels, crafted by an expert artist.

verses.kjv: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
verses.decoded: Your navel is like a round cup, always full; your stomach is like a pile of wheat surrounded by lilies.

verses.kjv: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
verses.decoded: Your two breasts are like twin young deer.

verses.kjv: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath-rabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
verses.decoded: Your neck is like a tall ivory tower; your eyes are like the pools of Heshbon near the gate of Bathrabbim; your nose is like the tower of Lebanon facing Damascus.

verses.kjv: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
verses.decoded: Your head is like Mount Carmel, and your hair is like purple cloth; the king is captivated by it.

verses.kjv: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
verses.decoded: How beautiful and delightful you are, my love, full of charm!

verses.kjv: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
verses.decoded: Your figure is like a tall palm tree, and your breasts are like bunches of grapes.

verses.kjv: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
verses.decoded: I said, I will climb the palm tree and hold its branches; now your breasts will be like grape clusters, and your breath will smell like apples.

verses.kjv: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
verses.decoded: The roof of your mouth is like the finest wine for my beloved, flowing smoothly and making even those who are asleep speak.

verses.kjv: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.
verses.decoded: I belong to my beloved, and he desires me.

verses.kjv: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
verses.decoded: Come, my beloved, let’s go out to the countryside and stay in the villages.

verses.kjv: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
verses.decoded: Let’s rise early and go to the vineyards to see if the vines are growing, if the grapes are tender, and if the pomegranates are blooming; there I will give you my love.

verses.kjv: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.decoded: The mandrakes give off their fragrance, and at our gates are all kinds of sweet fruits, both new and old, which I have saved for you, my beloved.

verses.kjv: O THAT thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
verses.decoded: Oh, that you were like my brother, who nursed at my mother's breasts! Then, if I found you outside, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.

verses.kjv: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.decoded: I would lead you and bring you into my mother's house, where she would teach me. I would give you spiced wine made from the juice of my pomegranate.

verses.kjv: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
verses.decoded: His left hand would be under my head, and his right hand would hold me close.

verses.kjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
verses.decoded: I warn you, daughters of Jerusalem, do not awaken or disturb my love until he is ready.

verses.kjv: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
verses.decoded: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? I raised you up beneath the apple tree, where your mother gave birth to you.

verses.kjv: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
verses.decoded: Place me like a seal on your heart, like a seal on your arm, for love is as strong as death, and jealousy is as fierce as the grave. Its flames are like blazing fire.

verses.kjv: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
verses.decoded: Rivers cannot wash away love, nor can floods drown it. Even if someone gave everything they own for love, it would be completely scorned.

verses.kjv: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.decoded: We have a younger sister who has not yet grown up; what will we do for her when the time comes for her to be married?

verses.kjv: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.decoded: If she is like a strong wall, we will build a silver palace on her; if she is like a door, we will protect her with cedar boards.

verses.kjv: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
verses.decoded: I am like a strong wall, and my breasts are like towers; then he saw me as someone who is special and pleasing to him.

verses.kjv: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
verses.decoded: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he leased it to caretakers, each of whom was to pay a thousand pieces of silver for its fruit.

verses.kjv: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.decoded: My vineyard, which belongs to me, is right in front of me. Solomon, you may have a thousand, and those who take care of the fruit two hundred.

verses.kjv: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
verses.decoded: You who live in the gardens, your friends listen to your voice; let me hear it too.

verses.kjv: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
verses.decoded: Hurry, my beloved, and be like a deer or a young stag on the mountains filled with spices.
